title: Concept: Certificate authority file configured but empty
description: .npmrc declares an empty `cafile` setting, which leaves the client with no trust anchor from that path, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The client falls back to whatever trust store the runtime happens to have, so the set of accepted registry certificates is unspecified.
risk: The client falls back to whatever trust store the runtime happens to have, so the set of accepted registry certificates is unspecified.
